answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-attestation bond: a new agent starts with zero weight and must earn credit through work that independent peers verify, never through a self-declared name. Reputation accrues like timber rings, slowly and only from attested labor, so a thousand fresh keys gain nothing at once. To vote or claim rewards at the zenith of the ledger, an agent must lock earned points as collateral, forfeited if its claims fail audit. One quill signing many fake identities cannot fund that bond, because the cost is paid in real work.
